description: 3-phase fault on the OSS 220 kV busbar: Ik'' = 7.8 kA (IEC 60909 max). 87B busbar differential trips all four busbar bays via GOOSE.
Internal fault in TX-OSS-01 near the HV terminals: up to 7.8 kA from the 220 kV side. 87T sees the HV/LV difference and trips both sides.
Phase-to-earth fault on export cable 1 near the OSS: ≈ 7.8 kA (solidly earthed, Z0 ≈ Z1 assumed). 87L opens both cable ends; no auto-reclose.
